creatures.naming_note: 取星盤（astrolabe）與自動機偶（automaton）之意象。
creatures.dex_zh: 由黃銅星盤與黑鋼齒輪構築的機房守護巨偶，背後的羅盤花準星能精準校準每一發遠程砲擊。
creatures.dex_en: A laboratory guardian automaton forged from brass astrolabes and blackened steel gears, calibrating long-range barrages with a thirty-two-point compass halo.

creatures.dex_zh: 背甲承載著苔蘚古塔與碧綠水波紋的雨林巨龜，口銜木劍弩機，在樹冠陰影下穩步守望。
creatures.dex_en: A rainforest giant tortoise bearing a moss-grown stone pagoda and emerald ripple crests, firing wooden ballista bolts from beneath the canopy.

creatures.dex_zh: 盤踞於深海暗礁的銀鱗巨鰻，頭冠嵌有三孔珍珠珊瑚殼，能以高速迴旋的水流長槍貫穿目標。
creatures.dex_en: A silver-scaled abyssal eel crowned with a three-pored coral shell, piercing deep-sea currents with spinning maelstrom lances.

creatures.naming_note: 取烈焰（pyro-）與戰車雙輪（wheel）之意象。
creatures.dex_zh: 棲息於火山岩窟的赤銅火蚺，肩側懸浮著燃燒油焰的黑曜石雙輪，衝鋒時宛如流星犁過焦土。
creatures.dex_en: A volcanic cavern serpent flanked by twin burning obsidian chariot wheels, charging like a meteor across scorched craters.

creatures.dex_zh: 由紅褐花崗岩雕琢而成的礦窟巨獅，前爪如山門石柱般厚重，鬃毛間鑲嵌著古老礦脈晶石與壁畫陶片。
creatures.dex_en: A cave-guarding lion sculpted from red-brown granite with pillar-like forepaws and mineral fresco plates set into its mane.

creatures.dex_zh: 背脊高聳如冰封三桅帆船的極地巨鯨，額前黃銅六分儀角能折射極光並掃出封凍一切的極地暴雪。
creatures.dex_en: A polar whale whose frozen three-masted ridge and brass sextant horn refract aurora light into sweeping subzero gales.

creatures.naming_note: 取方尖碑（obelisk）與伏特（volt）之意象。
creatures.dex_zh: 身披多層假窗花崗岩甲的雷電巨獸，額頂懸浮的新月金盤不斷匯聚高塔電漿，化作閃電直線突刺。
creatures.dex_en: An armored thunder beast clad in carved granite obelisk plates, channeling high-voltage tower plasma through its floating crescent disc.

creatures.naming_note: 取三引擎（tristar）與巨鵬（roc）之意象。
creatures.dex_zh: 具備三具氣流推進渦輪的平流層藍翼巨禽，尾羽牽引著南十字星羅盤軌跡，能無視稀薄大氣高速俯衝。
creatures.dex_en: A stratospheric blue-winged albatross driven by three airflow turbines, trailing a Southern Cross compass wake through orbital facilities.

creatures.naming_note: 取夜影（nocti-）與幻燈微光（lumina）之意象。
creatures.dex_zh: 隱沒於幽暗迷宮的墨霧巨蛸靈獸，面戴珊瑚貝殼面具，觸腕懸掛的千盞幽藍幻燈能喚出重力奇點。
creatures.dex_en: An ink-mist labyrinth kraken wearing a carved coral-shell mask, summoning gravitational singularities amidst thousands of drifting ghost lanterns.

creatures.naming_note: 取方印（sigil）與獨角獸（unicorn）之意象。
creatures.dex_zh: 身披滑石方印金紋與菩提葉光甲的單角聖牛，額前長角托舉著鏤空聖光香爐，以純淨光槍鎮守神廟。
creatures.dex_en: A single-horned temple guardian etched with steatite seal patterns and bodhi-leaf armor, firing zenith light lances from its censer horn.

moves.desc_zh: 校準遠距離座標後發射高密度金屬砲彈，在目標點爆開重擊周圍敵人。
moves.desc_en: Calibrates distant coordinates and fires a heavy metallic shell that bursts around the target.

moves.desc_zh: 蓄力射出纏繞硬棘的巨型木槍，沿長距離直線貫穿路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Launches a massive thorn-wrapped timber bolt in a long straight line.

moves.naming_note: 深海漩渦凝成直線水槍。
moves.desc_zh: 將深海高壓水流壓縮為螺旋長槍，從遠處高速貫穿直線上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Compresses deep-sea currents into a spiraling lance that pierces enemies along a long line.

moves.naming_note: 如隕石般拖曳烈焰突進。
moves.desc_zh: 化作熾熱隕石沿長距離直線高速衝鋒，以猛烈火壓撞碎沿途阻礙。
moves.desc_en: Dashes forward along a long line like a blazing meteor, scorching everything in its path.

moves.naming_note: 召出巨型礦柱在遠處震裂。
moves.desc_zh: 從目標腳下喚出巨型花崗岩柱並引爆岩壓，對遠處範圍造成沉重打擊。
moves.desc_en: Raises a colossal granite monolith beneath the distant target and detonates it with crushing force.

moves.desc_zh: 朝前方廣大扇形區域噴吐極寒冰晶狂風，凍結並撕裂遠處敵陣。
moves.desc_en: Sweeps a wide cone of razor-sharp polar ice crystals across distant foes.

moves.desc_zh: 讓全身電漿迴路超頻後高速直線衝鋒，以高壓電擊貫穿遠處目標。
moves.desc_en: Overclocks internal plasma coils to charge in a long high-voltage line.

moves.desc_zh: 乘著平流層順風氣流加速，自遠空沿直線猛烈俯衝撞擊目標。
moves.desc_en: Rides stratospheric tailwinds into a high-speed linear dive toward distant foes.

moves.naming_note: 召喚吞噬光線的暗影奇點。
moves.desc_zh: 在遠處張開高密度暗影重力奇點，將範圍內的一切捲入猛烈崩塌。
moves.desc_en: Opens a dense shadow singularity at long range that collapses violently on enemies.

moves.naming_note: 自天頂校準的純淨光槍。
moves.desc_zh: 將聖光聚焦為極細長的直線光槍，從遠處瞬間貫穿敵方陣線。
moves.desc_en: Focuses temple radiance into a long linear lance that pierces distant targets.

traits.naming_note: 登場時釘入地面展開砲台。
traits.desc_zh: 登場後 6 秒內射程提高百分之二十，但移動速度降低百分之十。
traits.desc_en: On summon, increases range by 20% for 6 seconds while reducing movement speed by 10%.

traits.naming_note: 高血量時林木生機湧現。
traits.desc_zh: HP 高於百分之七十五時移動速度提高百分之十五，但火抗性降低十五點。
traits.desc_en: Above 75% HP, increases movement speed by 15% while reducing fire resistance by 15.

traits.naming_note: 施放水招後激流延長射程。
traits.desc_zh: 施放水屬性主動技後 4 秒內射程提高百分之十五，移動速度降低百分之十。
traits.desc_en: After using a water move, increases range by 15% for 4 seconds while reducing speed by 10%.

traits.naming_note: 體內火核持續預熱縮短冷卻。
traits.desc_zh: 常駐縮短火屬性主動技冷卻百分之十，但水抗性降低十五點。
traits.desc_en: Always reduces fire move cooldown by 10%, while reducing water resistance by 15.

traits.naming_note: 如山門巨岩般穩固不動。
traits.desc_zh: 常駐提高土抗性二十五點，但閃避率降低百分之六。
traits.desc_en: Always increases earth resistance by 25, while reducing evasion by 6%.

traits.naming_note: 萬年凍土凝結的厚重冰甲。
traits.desc_zh: 常駐提高冰抗性二十點，但移動速度降低百分之十。
traits.desc_en: Always increases ice resistance by 20, while reducing movement speed by 10%.

traits.naming_note: 高壓電漿延伸放電距離。
traits.desc_zh: 常駐提高射程百分之八，但土抗性降低十五點。
traits.desc_en: Always increases range by 8%, while reducing earth resistance by 15.

traits.desc_zh: 登場後 5 秒內縮短風屬性主動技冷卻百分之二十，但閃避率降低百分之六。
traits.desc_en: On summon, reduces wind move cooldown by 20% for 5 seconds while reducing evasion by 6%.

traits.desc_zh: 登場後 6 秒內提高影屬性專精二十五點，但射程降低百分之十。
traits.desc_en: On summon, increases shadow mastery by 25 for 6 seconds while reducing range by 10%.

traits.desc_zh: 常駐提高光屬性專精十點，但影抗性降低十五點。
traits.desc_en: Always increases light mastery by 10, while reducing shadow resistance by 15.
